chapter: Kansas City, Basie, Prez and Booker Pittman
title: Booker and Ben go with Blanche Calloway; Booker to Europe
summary: Pittman and Webster join Blanche Calloway, and Booker later goes to Europe and South America.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Anyway, finally, Jap Allen's band broke up. Ben and Booker went with Blanche Calloway.
So Booker Pittman went with Blanche Calloway.
Yeah, and this is when they first migrated into New York, see. But I was still in Kansas City.
When they get back -- they must have come to Chicago before they got to New York, didn't they?
Yeah, because Blanch Calloway and all of 'em, they were battle -- having the battle of bands then, going all around the country, and Fletcher Henderson, and --
Did he -- did that -- who -- Booker, who joined Blanch Calloway?
Booker Pittman and --
Booker Pittman.
Edgar Battle.
Edgar Battle. They joined him in Kansas City?
Yeah, that's where they joined him, in Kansas City. Ben Webster --
That's right. Beautiful.
Yeah, they joined Blanch Calloway there, see, and then that's where we started to parting our ways.
Oh, yes.
Then, after Blanch Calloway had come to New York, through Chicago and all that, then Booker left, and I think he left with Tommy Ladnier Latin, or Booker Miley, or something, went to Europe.
Tommy Ladnier --
And he stayed over in Europe --
(Inaudible) didn't he?
Yeah, they used to be with Fletcher
Henderson.
Yeah, he had been -- he came (inaudible).
Yeah, he was from Arkansas.
He came out of Chicago, and in the south orchestra.

Yeah, great trumpet player. And then Booker went to Europe, and he traveled all over Europe, and then he settled in South America. In fact, he told me a very, very, very interesting story, before he died.
